clarifications.description: Human answers to earlier questions, verbatim, that narrow which options to generate.
clarifications.title: Clarifications

constraint_ids.description: Ids of evidence items stating constraints every generated option must respect.
constraint_ids.title: Constraint Ids

evidence_ids.description: Evidence the generated options may rest on.
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

existing_option_ids.description: Ids of options the caller already has, so generators do not duplicate them.
existing_option_ids.title: Existing Option Ids

findings.description: Accepted synthesis findings as `[id] claim`, so the host does not re-derive them.
findings.title: Findings

problem.description: The decision problem to generate options for, verbatim from the caller.
problem.title: Problem

propose_criteria.description: Whether to also propose criteria for human approval.
propose_criteria.title: Propose Criteria

require_grounding.description: Every proposed option must cite, in `source_refs`, evidence ids from `evidence_ids`.
require_grounding.title: Require Grounding

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version
